title: Eleven Pints and One Churn
subtitle: 乳制品与饮食 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 乳制品与饮食（生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：乳制品与饮食（生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：cream　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cream 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 my grandmother ① skimmed a cream that had stood eleven hours in the cold, and she said the skimming was the whole of the morning. The ② cream, meaning the fat and not the milk, filled eleven pints and stayed that much; cream, she said, is the only thing in a pan that is judged by how long it has been left alone.

Every ③ cream in that dairy had the same shallow pan, and the ④ cream at the end, meaning the one she kept for the visitors and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever spooned twice. Cream, my mother said, is nine parts pan and one part somebody willing to wait; my grandmother said the waiting is the part that fills eleven pints.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the cream was the whole of the list, meaning the best of them and not the fat. The ⑥ cream, meaning the best of them and not any of that, is the only thing in a list that everybody names and nobody defines; cream, he said, is either something you skim or the only word that means both a fat and the best of them. She said the best of them is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ cream had become a line in an account book, and the book had become an argument about the pan. The ⑧ cream of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in July, was one churn and thirty years of waiting; cream, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to wait. He said the waiting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ cream I remember is the one at the end, which she skimmed in 1970 and is still described as the thickest in the county. A ⑩ cream, my mother said in 1972, is the only thing that improves by being waited for; every cream, she said, is the best of them that has agreed to look like a fat. She said the best of them was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 奶油（指那层乳脂本身，与那些牛奶相对）
C. 固定搭配：skim a cream 撇取奶油
D. n. 奶油（指那家乳品房里每一份）
E. n. 奶油（指末尾那一份）
F. n. 精华；精英（the cream of 表示最优秀的部分）
G. n. 奶油（指账本里提到的那一份）
H. n. 乳脂；膏状物（抽象总称）

items.q: skimmed a cream that had stood eleven hours in the cold
The cream, meaning the fat and not the milk
the cream was the whole of the list

answers.why: skim a cream 意为“撇取奶油”，1956 年祖母撇取了在冷处放了十一小时的奶油。
cream 意为“奶油、乳脂”，指那层乳脂本身而不是那些牛奶，盛了十一品脱。
cream 指那家乳品房里每一份奶油，每一份都用着同样的浅盆。
cream 指末尾那一份（她留给客人的那一份），是唯一有人舀过两次的。
the cream of 意为“精华、精英”，父亲说精英就是那份名单的全部，指的是最优秀的那一部分而不是那层乳脂。
cream 为比喻用法，指最优秀的那一部分而不是那层乳脂，是名单里人人都点名、却无人下定义的东西。
cream 意为“奶油”，指账本里提到的那一份，到 1964 年这份奶油成了账本里的一行。
cream 意为“乳脂”，祖母七月写道，整件事的乳脂是一个搅乳桶三十年的等待。
cream 意为“奶油”，我记得的是末尾那一份，她 1970 年撇的，至今仍被说成全县最稠的。
cream 为抽象总称，母亲说一份奶油是唯一会因为被等待而变好的东西。
